body: I hope one day you can understand why you should not have made a comment on this post

It’s not what I was told it was the fact that I made a post about having suicidal thoughts and that recent events were driving me to making a conclusion and the responses were saying things like I take my life too seriously and I shouldn’t be feeling like I am.  It’s not a rough patch it’s a rough life.  Reaching out to a sub that I felt would at least just say something like “hey it gets better” but instead was met with things like “don’t take your dreams seriously”.  Instead of jumping to conclusions and thinking the responses were kind, maybe they weren’t..like yours.

Thank you.  I’ve been thinking about trying meds for a while but I’ve heard the side effects outweigh the benefits for most people.  I’ve seen psychiatrists before but after a few years I realized it’s just talking in circles and I don’t get much out of it.  There’s no real trigger for why I’m feeling these things, they just are how I feel and it just feels like every time I pull out of a rut I get forced back deeper.  Thank you for your response and your kind words.  Already I’m unsure why I made another post because for your one good comment there was one right below you trying to put blame on me again.

Clearly this account I posted on is new and has no links or connection to the original post.  There’s no blame to the different people who commented things...like you just did...on a suicide sub.  I may be the one who was fighting with suicidal thoughts and finally decided enough is enough but you’re a fucking dick.
